paragraphs.text:
It is straightforward to follow the fresh tracks left by the group. 
They lead you back to a nearby hollow. Looking down into it, 
you see a pathetic sight—a woman tied to a tree, as if staked 
out for the wolves.

This seems wildly out of character for the Tsuut’ina. What 
can she have done?
